notes.title: Full-release is out! Explore the islands now!
notes.content:
Hi, survivors!

It's been more than two years since Early Access (EA) opened on August 23, 2019. Now, I'm proud to announce that the game will be officially released!
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to join our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/K985c3A

Of course, we will keep updating Last Wood on [experiment] branch.
You're welcome to switch to [experiment] branch to experience more new contents!
How to: Right click on Last Wood in your Steam Library -> Properties -> Beta -> switch to experiment branch.

The following is the update log of "Island Exploration" for Ver 1.0.0 P27:

[h1]Island Colony[/h1]
We've added a new island-building feature: after defeating all enemies on the island, you can demolish the native buildings of the island and build your own base.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/1ee2dafe2fd76d0bd12cef0315a22635c9e60c52.jpg[/img]

In addition, there will be some resource terrain on the island, which can be exploited by new mining facilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/8cc669e5ba5e66ff61a7296412fa6b073c4b2200.jpg[/img]

[h1]Island Exploration[/h1]
Two new island types have been added: wasteland islands, fishman islands. And the original green land, desert, snow and rock islands have been added with special resources and tamable creatures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/186dab223307212d9e860e57feacff85b5f3e3f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/65c216e6776b645fde5f4ca79c36674bec4981a8.png[/img]

[h1]Wasteland Technology[/h1]
By searching for pre-war blueprints and pre-war trash on the wasteland islands, survivors can research and craft wasteland style architecture, artifacts, weapons and armor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/8e7535d6e70b01a9d0f8b2ffdbf4bc3ea6aed019.png[/img]

[h1]Ranching[/h1]
There are 15 new animals that can be domesticated, including a special hidden creature. Animals will interact with survivors and make them feel better. Some animals will produce animal products, but you have to feed them and wait for them to be matured. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/c217147d73e5a06f9adba300c018e01848a878d7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dyeing[/h1]
Building dyeing has been optimized. Players can now easily craft different kinds of dyes and customize your bases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/57108498252a743b12a58600d90946efad8c262b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other Content Expansion[/h1]
[list]
[*] 5 new animal products. 
[*] 4 new pre-war foods. 
[*] 2 new island special wild crops: Pumpkin and tomato. 
[*] 3 new seafood: Water fish, crab and lobster.
[*] 9 new cooking recipes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/e189356eb7ad4360d76ca2f58b081e94678f65ab.png[/img]

Dozens of new weapons and equipment: Wasteland series, Coral series and Crystal series. 
[list]
[*] 2 new pre-war medicine.
[*] 1 new faction: Raiders 
[*] 2 new dealers: Mole and divers 
[/list]

A series of new enemies: 
[list]
[*] Crystal fishman
[*] Crystal hammerhead Shark
[*] Bandit
[*] Ghost
[/list]

Don't forget to join LastWood Discord Server to share your play with us!
https://discord.gg/K985c3A

notes.title: Major update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey survivors!

Sorry for the absence, we have been working hard since last July to focus on the full-release update: "Island Exploration".

In this update, we add lots of new content and you would be able to build colonies on the islands. We will post a detailed dev blog about it soon.

Thank you for your support on our journey!

For any suggestion or further info, feel free to join our Discord channel:
https://discord.gg/K985c3A

notes.title: Ver 0.9.6f1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Ver 0.9.6f1
[olist]
[*] Cats can be tamed.
[*] Cats find empty rafts to rest on when sleepy.
[*] Cats find available food on rafts when hungry.
[*] Better unit UI.
[*] Add a new building: Pet food maker, could craft food for pets.
[*] Add a new buulding: Pet bed, pet could sleep better in beds.
[*] Cats find places first to sleep when sleepy.
[*] Cats find places first to eat when hungry.
[*] It's easier for survivors who love animals to tame cats successfully.
[*] Improved the model of pickle barrel.
[*] Fix the bug that some food couldn't be crafted into pickles.

notes.title: Ver 0.9.5f2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Ver 0.9.5f2
[olist]
[*] Changed the way to build paddles and other buildings need to be built near water.
[*] Fix the issue that room name display error on the building list panel.
[*] Increased the prob for floating survivors.
[*] Add new tools: Toolkit. Toolkit will increase building speed.
[*] Adjust the effect of artificial limbs.
[*] Chaoal  are more expensive, but will also last longer when brunt.
[*] Now watch spots can add camera range.
[*] Default count is set to one more than current count when swich to crafting mode keep X items.
[*] Items waiting to be consumed do not count to total items.
[*] Fix the type error of some items.
[*] Fruits and berry could provide hydrate now.
[*] Reduce the cost of some researches.
[*] Items in crafting buildings don't corrupt anymore.
[*] Survival knowledge panel spilit into several sub pages.
[*] Fix the issue that can not switch to floor9 from floor8.
[*] Add crafting info to some items like metal bars.
[*] You can now summon traders in the faction panel.
[*] Change the build resource for metal soil floors.
[*] Fix the display issue for survival knowledge panel.
[*] autofit work for difficulty selection panel.
[*] Fix the issue where it turns to be very lag when fragments of raft collide with an island.
[*] Traders on other rafts won't starve.
[*] Fix the issue that raft under a paddle remains even if the paddle has been cancelled.
[*] Now you can find way home for survivors from islands without changing the current floor.
[*] Add French translation text for achievements.
[*] Fix the issue that sometimes status bar hides inproperly.
[*] Status bar indicates when survivors salvage.
[*] Fix the error that tooltips would expand when rapidly toggle.
[*] Balanced the efficiency of brewing barrel and pickel barrel.
[*] Now you could hover on the consume and producing bar to see the progress percentage.
[*] There will be a message box when you get ancient god installed.
[*] Add a new kind of survival knowledge to increase load of survivors.
[*] Fix the issue where survivors sometimes get stuck with barrels on the sea.
[*] Now you could open Bug Report Feedback Panel on the main screen.
[*] Update the model of Ore Salvager. And now it consume Salvage net to operate. (Salvage net is expensive, but could last for a long time.) And it no longer requires charcoal and water.
[*] Adjust the transprotaion tech.
[*] Remake some of the item icons.
[*] Fix the error that deleted building will appear.
[*] Add a leaderboard of surviving days.
[*] Add tooltips for character creation panel.
[*] Add a hint when there is a save file with same name.
[*] Improved system panel.
[*] Adjust the spawn rate of cats.
[*] Enhanced the name ui of buildings.
[*] Fix the bug that steam trap don't deal damage.
[*] Fix the issue that thieffish disappears after reloading.
[*] Fix the issue that cat disappears after reloading.
[*] Survivors under aggressive mode do not attack cats automatically anymore.
[*] Fix the bug that mushroom log wounld consume wooden equipment.
[*] Fix the issue sometimes buildings are hard to be selected.
[*] Fix the bug that meat rack could craft pickles.
[*] Fix the bug that the building name hud would falsh.
[*] Fix the issue that raincollectors do not work sometimes.
[*] Change the shortcut for switching team to ALT+NUM1/2/3.

[/olist]

notes.title: Ver 0.9.3f3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Ver 0.9.3f3
[olist]
[*] Balance work for grow time of flax.
[*] Increased storage limitation for charcoal.
[*] Fix the issue that survivors behave strangely when ranged attack others on islands.
[*] Remake the model of barrel and leaking barrel.
[*] Remake the model of chest found while fishing.
[*] Flax now would produce seed if fully grown.
[*] Correct mistakes for English texts.
[*] Paddles and sails don't stop when survivors work on it alert.
[*] Survivors are less likely to refuse to work when they feel sick.
[*] Add glass wall and glass raft.
[*] Improved the skill trail panel.
[*] Improved baskit guide.
[*] Now certain kinds of items don't corrupt when there is heavy rain.
[*] Fix the issue that tooltips disappear when building.
[*] Fix the model error of woman hairstyle.
[*] Survivors feel sick when touch diry items.
[*] Add a new building: Septic Tank. It could convert feces into rot.
[*] Fix the UI error when open help panel pressing F1.
[*] Now you can set attack mode for survivors: Aggressive(attacks enemies when they come); Defensive(attacks enemies who are in view range); Ignore(ignores enemies)
[*] Fix the issue that hidden things on the ground disappear after reload.
[*] Now it's much harder for salt to corrupt.
[*] Adjust the effect of some early game food.
[*] Enhance the UI layout of plnat groth infomation.
[*] Add a new building, lemon battery light.
[*] Reduce the scope for defensive mode.
[*] Fix the model error of barrels.
[*] Improved UI for character panel.
[*] Update translation text.
[*] Tooltips following the mouse won't hide if [Show keyhint] turned off in option panel.
[*] Survivors entering alert mode will behave like aggressvie mode.
[*] Add more information when an equipment corrupts (whose equipment and where he/she is).
[*] An item can sustain extra one time attack when its hp is zero.
[*] Balance work about effeciency for fertilizer pool.
[*] Fix the issue that icon for alert mode blocks selecting survivors.
[*] Fix the issue that buildings get stuck when workers on it go to alert mode.
[*] Add more tooltips for priority panel.
[*] Add more ways to change priority without draging icons.
[*] Fix the issue that survivosr might hang when crafting.
[*] Improved text for social between survivors.
[*] Fix the issue that trees left alone when survivors working on it stop work.
[*] Remake the model and animation of Metal Workbench.
[*] Fix the model error of Aalcohol Distillator.
[*] Balacnced the cook time of some food.
[*] Fix some typos.
[*] Now walls can support rafts on upper floor.
[*] Add a key guide: how to hide all the key guides.
[*] Fix the hierarchy and size error of some UI.
[*] Fix the animation error of Karken in the special event.
[*] Add a shortcut key for copying buildings.
[*] You can set not prompt for certain dialogs.
[*] Fix the display issue for queue item in craft queue panel.
[*] When an item in a crafting queue in higher priority is not satisfied, survivors will try the items in lower priority.
[*] Fix an issue might cause tooltips following mouse always hide.
[*] Now you can turn the tooltips following mouse off or on in the option panel.
[*] Jobs won't be canceled when you force the survivor working on a tree to do other work.

[/olist]

notes.title: Dev Log #3
notes.content:
Hello all survivors.

It's the third monthly devlog. Daily updating work has continued for about a hundred of days!
Thanks all of you!

Let's check what we've added into game this month!

[h1]1.New contents[/h1]

We added lots of new contents as usual.

Including a dozen of functionality buildings, which help you get more survival experiences on the sea in a post-apocalypse world.
Also, a dozen of new kinds of craft buildings, base on which you can build a more great ship.
We've also added a dozen of new equipment and several new kinds of creature.

[b]New functionality buildings.[/b]
[list]
[*] Machine gun turret.
[*] harpoon turret.
[*] Cannon.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/d8e018a3a2ae0a28c49f105983edc3e0bd5d8758.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Mini Hermit.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/bedd21b3614d66bfbae1447c424c5619d987755e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/aae744f5992dbb93b1853f394c489949c3810491.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Steam Propeller.
[*] Charcoal Kiln. 

Steam buildings now consume water and charcoal instead of water and wood.

[*] Fish Man Workbench. 
It could only craft energy bow for now. It would be able to craft more fish man tech items in the future.
[/list]

[b]New craft buildings.[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 new window buildings.
[*] Remake the model of metal wall.
[*] Enhanced the models or corner walls.
[*] 3 structures: Fishiron wall, Fishiron raft and Fishiron stairs.
[*] Add a new kind of inclined wall.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/37729e5b135aa4296f2972083cc49324abe87965.jpg[/img]


[b]New equipment[/b]
[list]
[*] Fish Iron Baton
[*] Fish Iron Sword
[*] Fish Iron Hammer
[*] Energy Bow
[*] Fish Iron Helmet 
[*] Fish Iron Armor
[*] Remade Trident of Ice and Trident of Flame
[/list]

Look at these two guys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/612e3055e9178c1b2ed979b5fae85aa225ba4de0.png[/img]

A poor Raven comes, and they attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/af1276852f2df693b5f843ab0763aed3fc1016ff.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Gathering Knife
[*] Fish Iron Knife
[*] Pickaxes
[*] Fish Iron Pickaxes
[*] Metal Fishing-rod
[*] Fish Iron Harpoon
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/69e5182970a61a2847a6325692d34d4162d81bea.jpg[/img]

[b]New kinds of creature[/b]
[list]
[*] Metal Eater.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/030833d18c7ae7eb9865658eab5cd6d21f943ca3.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Giant Hermit.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/5b8dfd33a53d4e83ea127e6f8ca2f45cc075a16a.gif[/img]


[h1]2.Customize your character![/h1]

We've received many feedbacks about character creation since Last Wood launched EA, which said it's too frustrating to click [Random] hundreds of times to get a favored character. 

Actually, every character [generated] in game owns his or her own back stories.
Perks, traits and skill levels all depend on those back stories.
For example, Adam met a mysterious thing in his childhood might lead to a perk [Nightmare]. 

We hope it can be a bit different from other games, where charaters can be customized freely.

But, we also want to make it less frustrating on this process.
So, we changed the process for character creation.

Now, you have 5 points for each character when [creating] him/her.
Back stories of a character generates a pool of perks for him/her, and a series of base skill levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/49712cfd24906b881e04ba642f536acea8c438e9.jpg[/img]

You can use these points to select perks from the pool, or add extra skill levels.
It will lead to a more interesting character creation.

[h1]3. An extra tool slot[/h1]

Survivors can equip a weapon and a tool simultaneously now.
Use it just like other slots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/70d79dcd3a2df4eb3766415151f91a907e8c857b.png[/img]

[h1]4. Some kinds of buildings are movable now.[/h1]

No need to demolish and build a new one!

Click a building, and the [migrate] button is here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/a2fb9eefd149b64cafd56100a187e78b0203bc60.png[/img]

[h1]5. More functionality about jobs[/h1]

Some enhancement.
[list]
[*] Built-in jobs can be changed name and deleted.
[*] No need to set a job before renaming it.

[*] You can set a global temporary job for everyone.
[/list]
When you need all of your survivors to do a certain job, you can try this.
They will go back to their original work, if they were assigned a job before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/f5d349dabe3dba38435511cb9415582ac566a24e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can view and change jobs for survivors on the survivor panel.
[/list]
No need to open priority panel to assign job for survivors anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/10c04e9d84914e5c3d5efd551c1f7a44b9046867.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Survivors can be sorted by job on the priority panel.
[/list]

Which will helps you a lot to group survivors by their jobs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/fb0200ceb569b30d00fb5df552e48b69482afa30.png[/img]

[h1]6. Utilities[/h1]

[list]
[*] A switch to toggle weather effect.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/9b4404e9670e403f17d7a4371d070f5d64ebd948.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Add a switch to toggle decorative effects.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/a09b2a4cc9519cd66f227dbc11adcfaea25e9cf9.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Add a toggle on storage panel, which can be used to hide all entries whose corresponding item not exists in that building.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/6b3fa410fdce212397b7e924d375ea70564df730.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Add a [Open Save File Folder] button on system panel.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/cf3ba7cf4dfef0ddd3fd43fb93d3182704608812.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Now window can be maximum in window mode.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Add indicators to show pipe buildings connection state.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/f914aedd27b893c24b5742078e58c0161d4543a9.png[/img]

[list]
[*] camera pitch scroll bar
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/bba2df7f0eb355943e714aac371dab1c76944023.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] You can set interval day count for auto saving.
[*] Now you can configure a number to keep auto save files at a certain count.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/33cc49b01e2827fc7f33cd0fd62374791a8c8911.png[/img]

[h1]7. Communicate more with devs![/h1]

We always take every single feedback from community very seriously.
Every single question or feedback either on Steam or Discord Group(), which we reply as soon as possible.

Of course, there is also a fast way in game to report -- press F2 and tell what happened. 
This functionality helps us locates and fix many bugs and issues.

We've received nearly 2,000 [F2] report from over 20 different countries.
Thanks all of you!

We checked every feedback, and sometimes, we wanted to write a reply to whom uploaded that [F2], such as simply a word of thanks or an anwser to a question.
But it was hard for us to do so, since we had no idea how to contact back.

So, we introduce a new panel here.
You can check our replies on this panel!

Q:How to open it?
A:Press [F2] to open bug report panel, click the button on the top-left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/e6fc1a83c57cdfdda105feefd142f95b4684c852.png[/img]

Then once we replies, there will be shown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/e7607ce8ca9b0b64f26649efefa34104906d150a.png[/img]

[h1]8. Other significant changes[/h1]
[b]artificial limbs have different effects now.[/b]

[b]Optimization work on AI[/b]
[list]
[*] Survivors will take reasonable amount of food when they want to eat or drink.
[*] Now survivors are smarter to select route to land an island.
[*] Enemies now will do more kinds of things after killing survivors.
[/list]

[b]Optimization on interaction experiences[/b]
[list]
[*] More commands can be given to survivors:
    Right click to craft
    Right click to eat piles on the ground
    Right click to eat food in a storage box

[*] Most of the panels are draggable now.

[*] Selecting items is easier when you build a multi-floor big ship.
[/list]

[h1]9. More optimization work and bug fix![/h1]
It takes less memory and CPU to run smoothly now!

notes.title: Dev Log #2
notes.content:
Hello all survivors.

We've kept updating Last Wood daily for over 2 months. 
This will not happen without help of all of you.

During this month, we concentrate more on NEW CONTENTS.
Here we go.

[h1]1.Faction & Events.[/h1]

[b]You are not alone on the sea after the Fall now. [/b]
There is a faction panel showing other factions you've known.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/b4199206ba8809551f1f2ac2de7789adab4102a4.png[/img]

They will come on different purpose depends on how is your relationship.

[b]There are no more everlasting enemies now. [/b]
Instead, they ask for resources sometimes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/c5477236aa28954d5a2ca4fe371d808fa6692b78.png[/img]

[b]More things happen on floating rafts.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/6f01d557b45c926dbd96927641dd7236298a0f2a.gif[/img]

and other events:
Cages of Cannibal
Civil war between the Raven
Lonely survivor
Strange trader

[b]New characters.[/b]
Crimson Raven
Giant 
Relic Giant
Sun Boys
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/99fccc84a59d31d2ab07051cfee996a44798e8c6.jpg[/img]

[h1]2.New buildings.[/h1]
Slope Wall Corner (Tri)
Slope Wall Corner
Slope Wall
Metal Spike Wall
Potted plant 
Potted cactus  
Steam Lantern 
Angler Figurehead 
Remade-Sail
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/5ba72cee63f5aab668044cb69b7fe7c83636e938.jpg[/img]

With these new decorations, you can craft a more amazing Ironclad!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/53e81b6bbae1d0599ae796442cf1bba09879025b.jpg[/img]

Mass Controller is another new interesting building.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/ceefa78d3b6fe93830c277e83523dfb5e68d1c9d.png[/img]

With help of this building, you can craft your own submarine!
For example, you have some mass controllers.
Turn them on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/08961c9b7f25b96f2d101a5aebba6d78578ab62d.png[/img]

Wait for them to increase weight gradually.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/9815fb4a43ae15403035176758ce21946c6bd9b6.png[/img]

And your sealed metal ship will dive into sea.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/c081c11ef11132c6c27371c62911ac410aaa28ea.gif[/img]

Pipe Wall
Pipe Pillar

Free hands of your survivors. 
Once your pipe system are complete, survivors don't need to carry water themselves.
You have a water pump on the first floor, and a smelter on the second floor.

Build pipes to connect them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/d71e0e97f67ae7de3db8ea902d8348cdcba60da8.png[/img]

Once the water flows, pipes will connect to each other automatically.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/fad26f675f421a1eb5bb809c7c5da167b886d898.gif[/img]

Eventually, steampunk!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/09ed477bae0d856bf86509a8f523f1679fa6a180.png[/img]

[h1]3.New Equipment.[/h1]
Stone Armor
Stone Helmet
Spike glove  
Scrap axe  
Scrap Glove
Fire glove  
Steam hammer
Steam chain saw  
Steam smg  
Steam sniper 
Torch Helmet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/7881ecc2fc9b11a0d79b3213968d2197e1715a5e.jpg[/img]

[h1]4.New types of room.[/h1]
Weapon Room
Kitchen
Medical Room
Prayer Room
Recreation Room
Research Room

[h1]5.Other significant changes.[/h1]
[b]Craft panel remake[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/756067cf85a4f49c35cd47f6b75e557bd9f45fa2.png[/img]

It looks more friendly and easier to use.

[b]Free cook supply[/b]
Now survivors can supply materials for free cooking.

[b]Trade panel wealth indicator[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/20738d0bef2f88594c4fa77cf5b6176de6852788.png[/img]

[b]New room assign[/b]
Rooms are allowed to be into by anyone by default now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/f81e3e406347b28f24d7e9cacc1aa4824aeda2b9.png[/img]

[b]In-game help panel[/b]
Find how to produce a kind of item.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/c949bee5d26d4f3a6478ea3a1f5f0733d22daeed.png[/img]

Find what's the usage of a kind of building.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/c6f341ea73521925d5721adebbb9efbc1c2d8b4c.png[/img]

[b]Scale UI[/b]
Use mouse instead of keyboard to scale up and down.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/089276c13d8d66d51571467bd26dd40522a1af86.gif[/img]

[b]Shift fast building[/b]
Expand your rafts more quickly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/abc2d3e0e065bcb37828aadfdcdccf6a821706dd.gif[/img]

[b]In-game change mode[/b]
Change to the mode you want to play whenever.

[h1]6.Utilities.[/h1]
[b]Hide all torch.[/b]
Every torch generates a single point light. 
Hide them to improve performance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/f5db6ef0cfd00a5f100b7d3086b98ad1e975f38c.gif[/img]

[b]Clear salvage history.[/b]
One click to clear all of your salvage history.

[b]Survivors scavenge corpse automatically.[/b]
There is no need to Micro-Management for scavenging corpse anymore.

[h1]7.Bug fixes.[/h1]
Again handreds of bugs and enhancement were completed in the past month.

[*] Add some tooltips on trade panel.

[*] Add some tooltips on assist buttons on the top of the screen.

[*] Balance work about food.
[*] Fix the issue that water effect shows even that floor is hidden.
[*] Fix some display issues about HUD of survivors.
[*] Fix the issue that weapons don't work when survivors are hidden.
[*] Fix a display issue for building button.
[*] Change the background descriptions for some input boxes.

[*]	Improved continuous construction mode.
[*]	Fix the issue that no menu popups when right click on building buttons.
[*]	Fix the UI display error of wind speed.
[*]	Add sail's visual effect of switch on/off.

notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.content:
It's been a whole month since Last Wood launched EA. 
We have been updating Last Woody every day, tons of new stuff have been added in it! 

Let's have a quick walk-through.


[h1]1. Change limbs for crippled survivors.[/h1]
Assume there is a crippled survivor, who might experienced a brutal fight, and lost his leg.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/9d99050af467c4f73e9451d3742195934137ec06.png[/img] 

You can check his health status here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/e81159c34a57b464df1e98e6c300cc90f8bf749d.png[/img]

Reserve an artificial leg for him, which could either be crafted on a Metal workbench.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/d00b76464492708c1b00557251499855bbd78787.jpg[/img] 

Or bought one from a trader.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/66c6099f9ea521f9e08c087103887e6df4c5675f.png[/img]

Select this poor guy, check the "Health" tab. 
Click on the lost limb, select a new one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/c8b9af85416bb8413ae4ba61905569a355ce7255.png[/img]

Wait for his partner to help him. Then he is full of vim and vigour again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/a9492a899a4f1982d90f17cde9e608b8568690c4.png[/img]

[h1]2. Schemas for equipments/limbs/diet[/h1]
[b]Configure equipment for survivors.[/b]
He/She will find a substitute of same type when the old one is corrupted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/5dfc12705d88135ddf5715251e202b21aaa4a128.png[/img]

[b]Configure limbs for survivors.[/b]
The same as equipment schema.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/40e799602029eafc54553b097daec8f7dd4db84c.png[/img]

[b]Help your survivors have a balanced diet.[/b]
Right click on certain types of food to forbid a survivor to eat it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/158173bb3f78a7822826de45096f9c2ab9912fc6.png[/img]

[h1]3. Detailed priority settings[/h1]
Configure priority settings to group by survivors.
You are a captain now, make a clear division of labours. All of the staff in a certain role have the same priority settings.

e.g, You are in charge of three cook and four hamals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/1e12536bb959ee182f31f83c7fffa647c7cbef7f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/b46a28261c290732cc98fd97d2cd7201f17fd0aa.png[/img]

You want the 4 hamals not to do Clean work.
Select a hamal, right click on Clean to forbid it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/0e989a25a100a2fb79df169c770002bc9fead31a.png[/img]

Click on the downward arrow button next to his job.
Enable edit and click apply button (tooltips are "Use current order to override this preset").

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/3c98238369341ca8df5a5234a778e49f7660e6dc.png[/img]

Then all of your hamals won't do Clean work anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/1130bdcf9aef904c14bb9cffcce0a94a6280548c.png[/img]

Also, you can customize new jobs.

[h1]4. Craft automation[/h1]
Improved craft management.

Do a bill forever:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/ab618d99d64b30f163eca971462f7db6cc925f94.png[/img]

Do a bill keep the products at a certain number(global):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/8749b72ce1bc8fc9dd54a9331d3e47b0dc6e1514.png[/img]

[h1]5. Four different modes.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/d457d5194edab65fa61861f9f3b79dcfe05e3230.png[/img]
In peaceful mode, 
it's much easier for survivors to keep their sanity. 
Also, they will encounter few threats. 
Throw yourself into a post-apocalyptic world and enjoy your vacation!

In adventure mode, 
you will find it easy to meet survivor's basic demands.
Enjoy exploring the world and fighting strangers and creature.

In survival mode, 
survivors will be in danger if you don't meet their basic demands. 
Also, combat is a bit easier than it is in adventure mode.

In challenge mode, 
survivors live in a real post-apocalyptic world surrounded by water. 
It's harder for survivors to keep their sanity. 
Also, they will face more threats.

[h1]6. Some other major improvements.[/h1]
[b]Improved AI for supply work[/b]
Survivors now supply things and neaten rafts more effectively.

Look at this mess on the ground.
But two survivors tidy it up in a few seconds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/7e8e68ca49081e812d1d2e44af2d05c3c5ad372e.gif[/img]

[b]Improved click interaction[/b]
Left click will help you find the nearest thing from camera.
Right click will show all the things you clicked on.

[b]Endless generated world[/b]
No worry about reaching edges of the world and feel lonely anymore.

[h1]7. Many user-friendly utility tools.[/h1]
[b]Get out of stuck [/b]
Look at this dude, he is stuck caused by some weird reason (when you come across this kind of issues, press F2 to tell us! It will help a lot).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/c80a955323652f3868b94ea110afc01fa8fa1f7b.png[/img]

Then do as follow:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/d6a253751854eaf3157a50c2bfbcff7f4538588b.gif[/img]

He goes back to work!

[b]Select utility[/b]
If you want to select things only on current floor, press Z to avoid hover things on other floors.

[b]View structure utility[/b]
Press X to check internal structure of your rafts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/e4642b9b58f1e5b40959bdb50d1ad089f56c42d0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/301962756f0118f1654b492b83c581b9d8258873.gif[/img]

[b]Sea Farmer utility[/b]
auto chop down / auto plant 
Toggle it on, survivors will chop grown trees down automatically, and plant things as you wish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/92a993abfd5f78641934498f8e2772db5d382000.png[/img]

auto harvest 
Toggle it on, survivors will harvest the fruit automatically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/c51c16fbdf558a1a0b0fdc662828af66e9d46139.png[/img]

[b]Piles utility[/b]
Hide all piles on the ground
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/37f1c7d3a88843a58f4e29b83af514196850733c.gif[/img]

[b]Character utility[/b]
Press on the avatar image of a character to follow him/her, check what he/she is doing all the day!

[b]Item utility[/b]
Click item on the item panel (left on the screen) to jump to where it exists.

e.g. you want to find where your glass is. click on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/9de493404ddaf8ee52007630946d1812c33d0a50.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/2850a1a637e6bf3c3c1ab0f70fb21294bbcd5e4c.gif[/img]

[b]Builder utility[/b]
Repair all shortcut.
Click to mark all the rafts whose hp is less than 75% to be repaired.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/edcee7b2108da6efb2ce0bc1abf7366c9f499f26.png[/img]

[b]Dive utility[/b]
You can check dive history now.

[b]Copy-paste  utility[/b]
equipment schema / limbs schema  / diet schema  / priority settings schema  / storage settings schema 
All of these can be copied and pasted now.

[b]Auto level up[/b]

[b]Room panel select all / deselect all [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/43604c9554cb8505a662043c73d991198484c5f8.png[/img]

[b]Improved squad operation[/b]
Easier to guide survivors on islands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/1279a73e819336ba5067aea4dbdd1666490ee942.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/f88eb8a226cb22901ec54f482b74dcaa28802e8c.gif[/img]

[h1]8. New Contents![/h1]
New traders, buildings, equipment, items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/5551741366e904881c0e5b67310da197274c9308.png[/img]

metal water tank / skull hammer / new cooked fish 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/647c637495753e961908e75b98f35b7ec5924b3d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/4d2f9abac4971c3f8105178026fd508c6c3b3496.png[/img]

More challengeable enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/9dd7d4bd2f3d91c5f7cdfa492f429fed66fa80b1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/cf336f14ea1e8f1937098fb8b2846342527ceec3.png[/img]

armed enemies on islands.

[h1]9. Lots of bug fix, optimization, balance work![/h1]
Besides all of these above.
More than 200 bugs have been fixed during this month (thanks to all of our community and store page reviews).

Dozens of performance improvement.

More than 100 balance work.

----------------------------------------------------------
What do you guys want to see in Last Wood in the future? 
Comment below or chat with us on Discord: https://discord.gg/DjN6H5B
Email is also OK : justusgamelab@gmail.com

notes.title: V0.8.18 [Experiment] Branch Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, survivors!

Thanks to all of you, Last Wood has been updated from V0.8.1 to V0.8.17 since EA Launch.
Last Wood will absolutely not grow without of your feedbacks, criticism, and also, bug reports.

We will keep daily updating Last Wood to make it more complete, together with our community.

But, something will be a bit different from it was before.

We hope to put interesting things into game every day. But it's hard for us to cover the quality assurance work for daily major update.

Therefore, we create a test branch named [experiment].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32900109/a17aad75a7a31f9d9422a77b95cf8f096d41488b.png[/img]

[h1]What is branch [experiment]?[/h1]
Daily update now will be shipped into this branch every day as before, after a basic round of smoke test.
And after a fully, deep test, which always lasts for a few days, changes on the [experiment] branch will be merged into public default branch.

[h1]How do I switch to branch [experiment]?[/h1]
Open your Steam Library, Find "Last Wood", Right-Click on it. Select "Properties", switch to "BETAS" tab. 
Enter this code to get access to [experiment] : lastwood2019
Select the branch "experiment - public branch for experiment", and close the window.

[h1]Should I switch to branch [experiment]?[/h1]
It's highly recommended to switch to branch [experiment] for those players who are willing to help translate Last Wood in other languages, who want to know Last Wood more and could bear bugs, who are willing to get involved deeply in development of Last Wood.

Otherwise, it's better to stay on public default branch.

[h1]Then is it still updated daily on public default branch?[/h1]
Of course. But contents will be late for a few days to merge into public default branch.

[h1]How do I give branch-[experiment]-only feedbacks?[/h1]
Join our Discord Group : https://discord.gg/DjN6H5B 
There is a channel #experiment.

The following are patch notes for V0.8.18:

19	Fix the issue that survivors harvest always.
20	Increse the buoyancy of floating wood.
21	Increse the base load of survivors.
22	Fix an issue might cause survivors to repair something at a low priority
